title: The source endpoint of the Cartesian-centre span
statement: For the setting and any common Cartesian-centre span D of lem-pur-diagonal-etale-cartesian-centre-span, inverse restriction along D.left, restriction along D.right, and inverse section base comparison compose to the independently constructed source comparison for any normalized compact-support datum N. This assertion involves only the source section invariants and no deformation comparison delta.

proof.text: The ordinary restriction formula is functorial even without Cartesian centres. Apply its composition identity to D.factorization and cancel restriction along D.left.

Identify structural locality with the tensor-mate locality for arbitrary N by uniqueness of adjoint conjugacy and normalization_comparison_eq. The derived adjunction comparison aligns the two presentations.
The remaining inverse base comparison is the inverse smooth exchange in sourceOrdinary. Conjugating by canonical site comparisons gives the pro-etale formula.

lean.statement:
theorem span_source_endpoint (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {U X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (d : ℕ) (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    (h : U ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d h]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (e : U ⟶ X) [Etale e] (w : e ≫ g = h)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    (D : CentreSpan d g h e w) :
    (restriction P (h ≫ aY) D.left).symm ≪≫ restriction P (h ≫ aY) D.right ≪≫
        (baseComparison P (g ≫ aY) (h ≫ aY) (baseSquare d g e)).symm =
      source P d g h aY e w N
